rules: A published test procedure is not a measured validation dataset.
A vehicle specification is not evidence of field consumption or reliability.
A legal/administrative guidance page identifies a route to investigate; it is not a complete legal opinion or a vehicle approval.
Paid standards are referenced by metadata and link only; do not reproduce normative text.
No source is considered licensed for redistribution or commercial use until rights are recorded.
